description:
How is light coming from the stones? Where is the energy coming from?

After being puzzled by these artifacts for months, I took them to the best electrical mind I know, @dr.parkinstine.

Besides being an electrical savant, Parker also had an old diathermy machine that he used in conjunction with a special lightbulb to produce x-rays. 

Over the course of an evening we matched minds and machines in an attempt to explain the endless light coming from these rocks 🗿⚡️💡 #joefelz #energy 
#electricity #artifacts #archaeology #research #science #truthseekers #collab #dreamteam #xray #history #relic #tesla #unexplained #voltage #mystery #ancienttechnology #friendship #shocking #welcometothejoeshow
creator: joe felz, Parker Edmondson
